Versus

--Respondent
Hon’ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. Mohd. Matlub, learned counsel 
for petitioner.
2. This contempt petition is filed under 
Section 12 of the Contempt of Courts 
Act. The petitioner alleges the willful and 
deliberate non-compliance of the order 
dated 23.04.2026 passed by Coordinate 
Bench of this Court in WPSS No.21 of 
2019 Uma Rani Vs. Uttarakhand 
Transport Corporation and Another, 
whereby, while allowing the writ petition, 
Managing Director, Uttarakhand 
Transport Corporation was directed to 
reconsider the request for 
compassionate appointment made by 
petitioner within eight weeks and pass 
order as per law within the same time.
3. Learned counsel for petitioner 
submits that petitioner has served the 
copy of said order along with forwarding 
letter dated 13.05.2026 to respondent￾Managing Director, Uttarakhand 
Transport Corporation, which was 
received in respondent’s office on 
14.05.2026. He alleges that despite  more than eight weeks, the order dated 
23.04.2026 has not been complied with, 
thus, it is a sheer contempt of this 
Court’s order dated 23.04.2026.
4. Issue notice to respondent￾contemnor returnable within two weeks.
5. Steps to be taken within 03 days.
6. Put up on 25.09.2026.
7. Meanwhile, respondent-contemnor 
either to file response or to comply with 
the order dated 23.04.2026 passed by 
writ court.
 (Pankaj Purohit, J.)
 11.08.2026
PN
